user_query: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
clean_summary: The core issue was the flawed julianday-based year and month calculations; switching both to strftime-based year and month differences produces the correct average career span.
database_memories: ENSURE: Use strftime‐based year difference for final_game and debut instead of julianday division | CONTEXT: The table contains date columns final_game and debut storing player career endpoints; calculating year spans via julianday/365 led to small rounding errors | WHEN_TO_CHECK: When computing total career length in years from final_game and debut | EXAMPLE_USAGE:

ENSURE: Compute fractional months with strftime month subtraction divided by 12.0, not julianday modulus arithmetic | CONTEXT: Approximating month differences via (julianday(...) % 365) / 30.44 caused drift; month numbers are exact integers | WHEN_TO_CHECK: When deriving the portion of a year from month differences between two dates | EXAMPLE_USAGE:
generic_memories: VERIFY: Date‐difference calculations should leverage date extraction functions rather than raw day count division | PRINCIPLE: Directly extracting year or month components avoids imprecision inherent in dividing day counts by average lengths | WHEN_TO_APPLY: Whenever computing intervals in years or months between two date fields | EXAMPLE_USAGE:
When you need years between date1 and date2:
Correct: ABS(CAST(strftime('%Y', date2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', date1) AS INTEGER))

ENSURE: Fractional year components are calculated via precise component subtraction and proper division | PRINCIPLE: Using modulus on day differences and average month lengths can misalign actual calendar months; subtracting month integers yields exact month spans | WHEN_TO_APPLY: When decomposing a time span into integer years plus fractional months | EXAMPLE_USAGE:
To get months fraction after full years:
Correct: ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%m', date2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', date1) AS INTEGER)) / 12.0, 2)
